notes.text:
2-bit calculator

A and B are the inputs.
SUB off = A + B
SUB on = A - B (two's complement).
The result display shows the full 4-bit output from the adder IC, so subtraction can go negative in two's complement.

2-bit letter decoder

00 = H
01 = E
10 = L
11 = O

8-step melody player

A clock advances the 3-bit counter.
Logic gates decode each step into a note for the speaker.

toolboxICs.name: Half Adder
toolboxICs.description: Adds two 1-bit inputs into sum and carry.

toolboxICs.name: Full Adder
toolboxICs.description: Adds A, B, and carry-in using two half adders.

toolboxICs.name: 4-Bit Adder
toolboxICs.description: Chains four full adders for multi-bit math.

toolboxICs.name: Clock Divider
toolboxICs.description: Splits one clock into slower binary steps.

toolboxICs.name: Random Pulse
toolboxICs.description: A small clocked LFSR that outputs pseudo-random pulses.
